units: Proportions in [0,1]; 0.40 denotes 40%. Conditional severity is a separate unitless model quantity.
observation_model_mismatch: Clinical isolate susceptibility classifications and genomic samples are not equivalent to active-infection person-days with model any_r > 0. Small positive model effects do not necessarily imply clinical breakpoint resistance. No observation-model transformation is inferred here.

sources.citation: Saunders J et al. BASHH UK national guideline for doxycycline post-exposure prophylaxis for prevention of syphilis, 2025. doi:10.1177/09564624251352053.
sources.access: Full guideline HTML checked, antimicrobial resistance section.
sources.specimen_or_care_setting: Mixed literature; no single surveillance sampling frame
sources.checked_finding: Reports no observed doxycycline resistance in T. pallidum or C. trachomatis at guideline publication.
sources.use: Supports pragmatic T. pallidum near-zero prior only; does not establish an exact global prevalence.

sources.citation: Long GS et al. Genomic Analysis of Doxycycline Resistance-Associated 16S rRNA Mutations in Treponema pallidum Subspecies pallidum. Emerg Infect Dis. 2026;32(2):242-245. doi:10.3201/eid3202.251060.
sources.access: Full article HTML and Table 1 caption checked.
sources.observation_years: Canadian samples 2016-2024; most from 2024; global archival sampling years not extracted
sources.geography: Canada plus previously published global genomes
sources.specimen_or_care_setting: Genomic samples, not representative clinical breakpoint surveillance
sources.denominator: 17 Canadian genomes plus 784 published genomes; not a phenotypic tested denominator
sources.breakpoint_standard_version: Not applicable to this genomic observation
sources.checked_finding: No investigated putative doxycycline-associated variants observed; phenotypic relevance remains unvalidated.
sources.use: Context for structural prior; no genomic fraction is relabelled as clinical resistance prevalence.

sources.citation: Liu Y, Zheng X, Wu B. ATLAS analysis of Enterococcus faecalis/faecium susceptibility, 2019-2023. J Glob Antimicrob Resist. 2026;46:254-263. doi:10.1016/j.jgar.2025.12.018. PMID:41490597.
sources.access: PubMed abstract recovered via indexed primary-source search; publisher highlights checked. Full text attempts returned ScienceDirect 403 and JGAR inaccessible; tables/supplements not recovered.
sources.specimen_or_care_setting: Clinical isolates across wards and infection sites; detailed mix not recovered
sources.denominator: 6036 E. faecium isolates overall; drug-specific tested denominators not recovered
sources.checked_finding: Abstract gives susceptibility above 90% for tigecycline and linezolid, with no exact all-region resistant percentage for either.
sources.use: Unassigned pending recovery of drug-specific resistant results and criteria; do not subtract susceptibility from 100 or substitute highest regional resistance.

sources.citation: Coombs G et al. AGAR AESOP Bloodstream Infection Annual Report 2024. Commun Dis Intell. 2025;49. doi:10.33321/cdi.2025.49.053. PMID:41248469.
sources.access: Full publisher PDF checked, methodology, Table 2 and breakpoint reference.
sources.specimen_or_care_setting: Bloodstream episodes; hospital and community onset
sources.denominator: 593 E. faecium tested for linezolid; 599 E. faecium episodes overall
sources.checked_finding: Table 2 explicitly separates susceptible and resistant counts.
sources.use: Geographically and clinically restricted context; no transformation to a global model target. Ampicillin/amoxicillin remain missing.

sources.access: Publisher abstract and reference list checked; PDF/full Turkish article not checked.

sources.denominator: 241 E. faecium overall; drug-specific tested denominators not recovered from abstract

sources.checked_finding: Abstract reports 1.2% tigecycline resistance and no linezolid resistance detected in E. faecium.
sources.use: Single-centre context only; no Turkish percentage substituted into a global reference.

sources.denominator: 118 recovered clinical isolates from 1011 female samples

sources.checked_finding: Reports distributions for tetracycline, levofloxacin, azithromycin and rifampicin.

source_registry_additions.description: Near-zero prevalence prior with centre 0.0; evidence primarily doxycycline/tetracycline; minocycline is class-based only. See review.json sources saunders_bashh_2025 and long_eid_2026. No measured global zero or confidence bounds asserted.
Preserved model-scale conditional severity for rare positive simulated infections when prevalence prior centre is zero. Values inherited unchanged from v1; not clinical breakpoint estimates.

Legacy E. faecium tigecycline/linezolid references withdrawn. Exact all-region resistant results and susceptibility criteria not recovered from ATLAS; geographically restricted studies not used as global proxies. See review.json.

Thirteen positive C. trachomatis legacy references lack compatible species-drug provenance beyond a generic bacterium note; withdrawn pending review. Korean 2016-2019 susceptibility study does not validate global acquired-resistance targets.
